main_text.p: tè & fubitò uenit illius contritio.Et eft con tritio eius ficut contritio uafis figulorum, quod citra commiferationem comminui-tur,nec inuenitur in eius conquaffatione ulla tefta,qua uel ignis ferri poffet ab incé-dio,aut hauriri aqua de fouea. Quoniam fic dicit Dominus Deus,fanctus Ifraelis: In refipifcentia & quiete faluabimini:in tran-quillitate & fiducia erit fortitudo ueftra. fed noluiftis.Dixiftis enim:Non,fed per e-quos effugiemus (hoftem:) propterea fu-gietis.& fuper(animal curfu)leue afcende-mus:propterea uelociores erunt perfequu tores ueftri.Mille quafi unus (fugient) à fa-cie increpationis unius : & à facie increpa-tionis quinq;,(omnes)fugietis,donec reli-cti fueritis quafi malus nauis in uertice mõ tis,& quafi uexillu in colle. Propterea ex-pectare (uos) facit Dominus,ut miferea tur ueftri, quatenus exaltetur quum propitia-tus fuerit uobis : nam Deus iudicij eft Do-minus: beati omnes qui expectant eum.Si populus in Zion federit &in Ierufalé,flen-do non flebis: fed miferendo miferebitur tui ad uocem clamoris tui: & cum ipfe au-dierit,refpodebit tibi. Et fi dedit uobis Do minus panem tribulationis, & aquam af-flictionis:

page.notes: The page number at the top left is badly worn; "196" is a guess, hence [?]. "miferea tur" is printed with a space at the line end; it is copied as printed. The "ô" over "mõ" is a macron-like mark and is copied as "õ". The text ends mid-sentence at the foot of the page, so it continues on the next page.
